summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.72/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.72 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 11, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest since September 2. AAA figures put the statewide average 32¢ lower than a week ago, 31¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.01 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Sheboygan ($3.50) and the highest in Rhinelander ($4.01).
